snippet.title: P5R : Rose & Violet - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Rose & Violet is a story overhaul mod for Persona 5 Royal on PC. This mod is made to be used alongside Wisteria's excellent mod "Kasumi as Protagonist".

The mod available here: https://gamebanana.com/mods/593378
Check the mod description for the list of all the features.

Kasumi as Protagonist by Wisteria : https://gamebanana.com/mods/573578

My deepest thanks to everyone who contributed to this mod! This has been quite the journey!

Note : No new romances in this mod yet. Those will be looked into later. It's a lot of work, trust me.
